text: Appeal of Order to Comply (October 26, 2017) for 2886 Kingston Road.

Property Standards Committee, Scarborough Panel: 1. Confirmed the order to comply, dated October 26, 2017, for 2886 Kingston Road, Folder No: 17 253799 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to June 15, 2018, to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
